name: Clube do Choro de Lisboa
venue: Various venues around Lisbon (concerts + informal rodas)
frequency: Concerts and rodas through the year; no fixed weekly slot found.
notes: Long-running choro promotion group in Portugal (led by Tercio Borges). Also covered by Público and RTP.

name: Clube do Choro do Porto
venue: Teatro Municipal de Matosinhos (Constantino Nery), Avenida D. Afonso Henriques, 4454-510 Matosinhos — home of their "Choro no Nery" series
frequency: Recurring "Choro no Nery" series, roughly every couple of months — next confirmed date 7 December 2026, 19h00.
notes: Founded in 2018 by musician Chico Bastos with Saulo Giovannini and Felipe Bastos. Runs the "Choro no Nery" roda series at Teatro Municipal de Matosinhos, ticketed through the municipality (constantinonery.bol.pt). Also occasionally listed on Porto's own cultural agenda.

name: Club du Choro de Paris
venue: Often at Maison du Brésil (Cité Universitaire) after concerts
frequency: Runs an annual Paris choro festival plus occasional open rodas after concerts.
notes: Active since 2001; also see festivaldechorodeparis.org for the annual festival + workshops.

name: La Roda de l'Ouest
venue: Osmoz Café, 33 rue de l'Ouest, 75014 Paris (Métro Gaîté)
frequency: About once a month, a Tuesday or Thursday evening from 20h (day varies).
notes: Organized by Vincent Duhazé. Listed in Club du Choro de Paris' own venue directory.

name: Roda de Choro des Lauriers
venue: Les Lauriers (bar/restaurant/hotel), 98 rue des Couronnes, 75020 Paris
frequency: Several Thursday evenings a year, from 20h30.
notes: The venue itself (Les Lauriers) can also be contacted directly to ask about upcoming dates.

name: London Choro Festival
venue: Copper Cats, Dalston, London (confirmed venue for all 2026 festival events)
frequency: Annual festival — 2026 edition runs 16–18 October, all events at Copper Cats.
notes: Good hub for London's wider scene. Own Instagram: @londonchorofestival. Own YouTube channel: @LondonChoroFestival.

name: Choro East
venue: Three Colts Tavern, 199 Cambridge Heath Road, London E2 0EL (near Bethnal Green)
frequency: Fortnightly, ongoing — next confirmed date is 7 September 2026, then continuing on a fortnightly basis.
notes: The venue itself lists this as a recurring fortnightly jam, part of the London Choro Festival scene. Direct contact: info@threecoltstavern.co.uk (bookings@threecoltstavern.co.uk for reservations). Instagram @choroeast worth following too.

name: Zucca Roda de Choro
venue: Zucca Brazilian Deli, Golborne Road, Portobello Market, London W10
frequency: Ongoing, not fixed — announced individually on Instagram.
notes: A street food stand at Portobello Market (Golborne Road end). The deli's own Instagram has posted directly about its roda de choro; the roda is also promoted through Regional do Grafton's Instagram. An ongoing, informally scheduled session rather than a fixed weekly date.

name: GC Pianofabriek — Roda de Choro
venue: GC Pianofabriek cultural centre, Saint-Gilles, Brussels
frequency: Periodic roda events hosted at this cultural centre.
notes: Also occasionally listed on visit.brussels city agenda. Exact street address not independently confirmed — check the official page.

name: Berliner Roda de Choro
venue: Location varies by session, Berlin
frequency: Historically once a month, Sunday afternoon.
notes: ⚠ Organizer's own site states this roda is "currently paused" as of last check. Email info@matthiashaffner.com to ask if/when it resumes.

name: Roda de Choro City West (Musikschule City West)
venue: a Livraria Buchhandlung (bookshop-café), Berlin
frequency: Periodic sessions with the Musikschule City West choro ensemble (led by Eudinho Soares).
notes: Check the Deutsch-Brasilianische Gesellschaft (German-Brazilian Society) events calendar for current dates.

name: Roda de Choro @ Splendor Amsterdam
venue: Splendor Amsterdam, Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat 116, 1011 LX Amsterdam
frequency: Irregular — appears on Splendor's agenda under names like "Roda de Choro" or "O Choro Club do Rio Amstel".
notes: Real venue with its own booking calendar — search/filter their agenda for "choro". Contact: info@splendoramsterdam.com

name: Wiener Choro Klub
venue: Various Vienna venues (functions more as a performing ensemble than an open jam)
frequency: Occasional concerts (e.g. Neruda venue) rather than a confirmed open roda.
notes: Real, active ensemble (also covered by ORF radio) but we could not confirm an open jam-session format — likely closer to ticketed concerts.

name: Roda de Choro de Madrid
venue: Location varies (also busks around Madrid). An older (2014) source names "Liber Arte" as a past venue — may no longer be current.
frequency: Unconfirmed — appears active as a group (has released recordings) but no public schedule found.
notes: Group has a Bandcamp page confirming it's an active ensemble: rodadechorodemadrid.bandcamp.com. No independent site found for current venue/dates — this is one of the weaker-confidence entries on the map. Not confirmed whether this is the same project as the separate "Los Choros de Madrid" entry, which uses different branding entirely.

name: Los Choros de Madrid
venue: Various Madrid venues — has played Café Berlín (Malasaña) and Madreams
frequency: Occasional ticketed shows, including a Día Nacional do Choro (Brazil's national choro day, 23 April) concert — no fixed weekly recurring slot found.
notes: A well-documented, actively performing choro group with real ticketed shows at known Madrid venues and inclusion in the city's own "21 Distritos" cultural programming. Distinct from this map's separate, thinner "Roda de Choro de Madrid" lead — not confirmed whether these are the same people under different branding.

name: Roda de Choro (Centres Cívics de Barcelona)
venue: Hosted at one of Barcelona's municipal "Centres Cívics" — exact centre varies by session
frequency: Unconfirmed frequency — listed as a recurring activity type on the city's own cultural-centres site.
notes: This is Barcelona's official municipal cultural-centres website (not social media), which is a strong sign it's a real, city-supported activity — but the page blocks automated checking, so open the link yourself to see which centre and date is current.

name: Clube do Choro de Torino
venue: Locanda Clandestina, Via Baretti 16, San Salvario (Thursdays) · Circolo ricreativo Mossetto (Sundays)
frequency: Reported as weekly: Thursdays ~20:30 at Locanda Clandestina, Sundays ~20:00 at Circolo Mossetto.
notes: Organized by musician Marco Ruviaro, active in Turin's choro scene since ~2010 (see marcoruviaro.com). The article isn't dated, so confirm the weekly slots are still running before you go — this looks like the most "joinable" weekly roda on the whole map if current.

name: Roda de Choro — Corte dei Miracoli
venue: Corte dei Miracoli (circolo/theatre), Milan
frequency: Periodic choro nights, irregular — most recently referenced via an Instagram post; earlier sessions also happened at circolo La Scighera (Bovisa).
notes: Corte dei Miracoli is a real, ongoing cultural venue (also listed on Fever and BookCity Milano), so it's a legitimate place to check — but choro nights there appear occasional rather than a fixed weekly date. A separate Facebook group "Jam Session Brasiliana a Milano" covers the wider informal scene.

name: Chora Cambridge
venue: Panton Roda at the Panton Arms (regular) · summer Roda at The Granta (seasonal)
frequency: Weekly, Mondays 7pm at the Panton Arms; seasonal summer session Mondays 2pm at The Granta.
notes: Also listed by the University of Cambridge's Centre for Music Performance and CamJazzFest. Has a real contact email: choracambridge@gmail.com. One of the most reliably 'just show up' entries on the map. Occasional special rodas may run at other venues (e.g. the Sir Isaac Newton pub), sometimes around bank holidays — the official site currently only lists Panton Arms and The Granta, so treat any additional venues as worth watching for rather than confirmed.

name: Roda de Choro @ The Harrison
venue: The Harrison (pub/hotel), Kings Cross / Bloomsbury, London
frequency: Not fixed — announced individually, same as this group's other ad-hoc London rodas.
notes: Despite The Harrison's own site listing this as an event, it's actually advertised through Regional do Grafton's Instagram, with Alvorada involved as performers. No fixed schedule. Alvorada can also be reached directly at contact@alvoradamusic.com.

name: Choro München
venue: Lavan Cafe & Bar, Schleißheimer Straße 48, 80333 München
frequency: Regular jam sessions, exact day/cadence not published — check their own channels.
notes: Run by Abdallah Harati and João Araújo. Has its own website plus a WhatsApp group (linked from the site) alongside Instagram/Facebook @choromuenchen — the website makes this a real non-social entry point even though day-to-day scheduling likely happens in the WhatsApp group.

name: Festival de Chôro München
venue: Kulturzentrum LUISE, Ruppertstraße 5, 80337 München
frequency: Annual-ish festival (multiple editions since at least 2023); includes a roda de chôro as part of the day's program.
notes: Organized by Lusofonia e.V. with Kulturzentrum LUISE. Real cultural centre with a phone number and email (info@luise-kultur.de). One day, but a good yearly anchor for Munich if the regular Choro München jam isn't running when you're there. No separate social account found for the festival itself — Choro München's own Instagram/Facebook (@choromuenchen) is the best social channel to watch.

name: Roda de Choro (OBA)
venue: Varies — organized by OBA, a Brazilian music community in Copenhagen
frequency: Unconfirmed — listed under OBA's ongoing community initiatives, not a fixed weekly slot.
notes: OBA (obamusic.dk) runs this as one of their 'Community & Culture' programs; their own site doesn't publish a fixed venue or schedule, so check the events page directly or use their contact form (obamusic.dk/contacto).

name: Regional Massapê
venue: Varies — one known session was at Board, 29 Clanbrassil Street Upper, Dublin 8
frequency: Unconfirmed — only one past event found (a Brazilian percussion class + open roda), no evidence yet of a regular series.
notes: The one confirmed event (organized by a group called Regional Massapê) had already ended by the time this was checked. Included as a real lead worth watching rather than a confirmed recurring roda — this Eventbrite search stays live for whatever they post next. No dedicated social media account found for this group.

name: Roda de Choro (rotating venues)
venue: Rotates — seen at Au Camionneur (Quartier Gare) and LAÀB (1 Rue du Bain Finkwiller)
frequency: Described on one listing as "une roda comme d'habitude" (a roda as usual), suggesting an established but irregular series rather than one fixed venue/day.
notes: Linked to the group Quero Quero Choro, which lists its own roda page directly on its website (queroquerochoro.com). Also occasionally covered by Strasbourg's own tourism site (visitstrasbourg.fr) and city agenda (jds.fr) — worth searching those directly since specific listings come and go.

name: Roda de Choro de Marseille (Zoumaï)
venue: Not confirmed — organizer name is Zoumaï
frequency: At least a 2nd edition has been held, per a local cultural agenda listing — exact cadence unconfirmed.
notes: A dedicated Facebook page exists for this roda specifically, hosted at the Zoumaï brewery/bar (which also has its own page). Also covered by a local press piece (Bonjour Brasil / CityPost). A local cultural-agenda listing (agendamistral.fr) mentions it too but loads unreliably — Facebook is the more consistent link for now.

name: Roda de Choro & Samba
venue: Not specified on the listing
frequency: Unconfirmed — funded as an ongoing project rather than tied to one publicized recurring date.
notes: Funded by Leeds City Council through the Leeds Cultural Investment Programme, which is a solid legitimacy signal for the underlying project. However, the specific listing page this entry used to link to (visitleeds.co.uk/.../roda-de-choro-samba/) has gone offline (404) as of 2026-08-30, and a search for a replacement dedicated page or organizer social account (search engines, Jazz Leeds listings, Leeds Cultural Investment Programme news) turned up nothing current. checkUrl now points to Visit Leeds' own live "What's On" listings page as a working fallback — search "choro" there by hand to see if the event has resurfaced under a new listing before relying on this entry.

name: Roda de Choro de Dresden
venue: Not confirmed
frequency: Unconfirmed
notes: A real Facebook page exists for this group, but no venue, frequency, or independent source could be confirmed. Included as a lead worth checking rather than a confirmed recurring roda.

name: Conjunto Choro di Napoli
venue: No single fixed venue — has played Ennò, Lanificio 25, and other Naples spots
frequency: Occasional performances/rodas; no fixed recurring schedule found.
notes: A real, active choro ensemble that has performed rodas at multiple Naples venues (including Ennò and Lanificio 25). No independent website or fixed recurring venue found — their Facebook page is the best source for upcoming dates.

name: Circolo Odeòn (Roda de Choro Bologna)
venue: No fixed venue confirmed — has played Pub Sunshine and other Bologna spots, plus touring dates elsewhere in Italy
frequency: Active, ongoing group; functions more as a touring ensemble than a fixed weekly open jam, so no set schedule was found.
notes: A real, organized ensemble blending Brazilian choro with Italian instrumental traditions (Romagnolo liscio, Bolognese filuzzi), grown out of years of choro rodas in Bologna. Shares musicians with Turin's Clube do Choro de Torino and with Choro Camp Italia.

name: Choro Camp Italia
venue: Fattoria del Dono, a countryside farmhouse in San Lazzaro di Savena, just outside Bologna
frequency: Annual multi-day camp (2025 edition: 5–8 June); includes rodas de choro as part of the program.
notes: Run by Choro de Rua (Marco Ruviaro and Barbara Piperno) — Ruviaro is also behind Turin's Clube do Choro de Torino and Bologna's Circolo Odeòn. A study/practice camp rather than a weekly roda, but a solid yearly anchor for Italy if the dates line up with a trip. Only one edition confirmed so far, so recurrence isn't guaranteed.
